reviews.title: Glassdoor App issues
reviews.text: I recently downloaded the app hoping for a better experience but not only is it forcing me to sync my indeed profile, but now I don’t have access to Glassdoor community which is what I loved most and what the app did best. To access that, I have to use my web browser, and I have to say, that defeats the purpose of having an app in the first place. So I still think Glassdoor is cool but because of the app, I give it 2 stars
